title: COVA: China Online Visa Application
before: Create a COVA account with your email and choose the mission where you'll apply (for example the Chinese Visa Application Service Center in Beirut).
COVA dates are year-month-day. The dates below are already in that order.
Have a digital copy of your visa photo ready: COVA asks you to upload and crop it first.

sections.title: Personal information
yourself: Chinese name and other names, if any

sections.title: Type of visa
yourself: Validity and longest stay you're asking for

sections.title: Work

fields.label: Employer or school, and its address

yourself: Employer's phone number, your supervisor's name and your work history for the last 5 years

sections.title: Education
yourself: Your highest level of education and the school's name

sections.title: Family
yourself: Your spouse's, parents' and children's names, nationalities and dates of birth

sections.title: Travel

fields.label: Who will pay for the trip

yourself: Inviting travel agency or person: name, address and phone, as on your invitation

sections.title: Previous travel

fields.label: Have you been to China before?
Ever refused a Chinese visa or entry?

yourself: Countries you visited in the last 12 months

sections.title: Other information
yourself: Yes/no questions on health, criminal records and earlier visa overstays. Answer each one yourself.

sections.title: Declaration
yourself: Confirm the form is yours and true, then submit. Print the confirmation form and sign it.

after: Book a visit to the Chinese visa centre and bring the printed, signed COVA confirmation, your passport, photo and the documents on your checklist.
Give your fingerprints there and pay the visa and service fees (cash in US dollars in Beirut).
Collect your passport on the date on your pick-up form and record the decision on your dashboard.

sources.label: Chinese Visa Application Service Center, Beirut: L visa
